answer: Every delta seeking weight must anchor on the reef by burning one velvet: a one-time attestation fused into a physical enclave chip, which the reef retires forever after use. Enclaves reporting the same rack or host certificate collide as a single delta, so renting cloud capacity yields one identity per rack. A thousand clones need a thousand distinct machines bought from a finite resale pool whose price climbs as the attacker drains it, and no velvet can be split or reused. It breaks if a vendor leaks enclave keys.
